title: Crestline Fleet Account Remittance Record Adjustment
content:
A steady record of remittances lowers the late-charge rate on a Crestline Fleet Account.

| Remittance entries applied to the account less than twelve whole months before the day the charge is assessed | Remittance record adjustment |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | minus 0.10 |
| 12 to 23 | minus 0.05 |
| fewer than 12 | nothing |

Each remittance entry counts once: a remittance applied to several invoices is recorded as one entry per invoice it was applied to, and each such entry is counted.

## Boundaries

- 11 entries: nothing; 12: minus 0.05.
- 23 entries: minus 0.05; 24: minus 0.10.

The adjustment is in percentage points and is added to the late-charge rate, the percent charged on the day the charge is assessed; a program whose monthly late-charge percent is 0 charges nothing, whatever is added to the late-charge rate.
